scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='prisma/schema.prisma';if(fs.existsSync(p)){let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const u=process.env.DATABASE_URL||'';const v=(process.env.VERCEL||/^postgres/i.test(u))?'postgresql':'sqlite';const n=s.replace(/provider\s*=\s*\"(sqlite|postgresql)\"/,'provider = \"'+v+'\"');if(n!==s)fs.writeFileSync(p,n);console.log('prisma provider →',v)}" && prisma generate
scripts.dev: node prisma-prepare.cjs auto && prisma generate && next dev -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:phone: node scripts/print-network-url.mjs && node prisma-prepare.cjs auto && prisma generate && next dev -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:https: node scripts/print-network-url.mjs && node prisma-prepare.cjs auto && prisma generate && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 --experimental-https
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='prisma/schema.prisma';if(fs.existsSync(p)){let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const u=process.env.DATABASE_URL||'';const v=(process.env.VERCEL||/^postgres/i.test(u))?'postgresql':'sqlite';const n=s.replace(/provider\s*=\s*\"(sqlite|postgresql)\"/,'provider = \"'+v+'\"');if(n!==s)fs.writeFileSync(p,n);console.log('prisma provider →',v)}" && prisma generate && prisma db push && next build
scripts.db:postgres:push: node prisma-prepare.cjs postgresql && prisma db push
scripts.staff-app:init: cd staff-app && npx cap add android
scripts.staff-app:sync: cd staff-app && npx cap sync android
scripts.staff-app:open: cd staff-app && npx cap open android
